issue.title: MeetingNotes out-of-order preview order flakes under full portable-check
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `Tests/CaptureCoreTests/MeetingNotesSessionTests.swift::MeetingNotesSessionTests.testOutOfOrderPreviewCannotReplaceNewEventSelection`
- **Repro:** `just portable-check` (full suite)

Full `just portable-check` on bob-mac-capture master 46c5202b failed one test out of 2846 (1 skipped): MeetingNotesSessionTests.testOutOfOrderPreviewCannotReplaceNewEventSelection, with XCTAssertEqual order mismatch at Tests/CaptureCoreTests/MeetingNotesSessionTests.swift:135 — got [new, old], expected [old, new]. Immediate isolated rerun `swift test --filter MeetingNotesSessionTests.testOutOfOrderPreviewCannotReplaceNewEventSelection` on the unchanged tree passed. All CaptureSnoozeWakePolicyTests, SnoozeWakeSchedulerTests, and BobProcessClientTests snooze cases passed in both runs. Untouched by finish_mac_snoozed_agenda (no MeetingNotes source changes in 46c5202b).

task_type_fields.evidence: Fail/pass observations: 1 failure in 1 full portable-check run (2846 tests, 1 skipped, 1 failure); 0 failures on immediate isolated rerun of the single test on the same tree. Fail rate so far 1/2 runs of this test (full-suite context fails, serial single-test passes). Serial vs parallel: full suite runs the whole package in parallel; single-test rerun was serial and passed. Failure looks like an async out-of-order preview ordering race, not a deterministic regression.

issue.creation_reason: Unrelated flake surfaced during finish_mac_snoozed_agenda verification; snooze scope is green and the failure is in untouched MeetingNotes code.
